title: ANAPTYSBIO, INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: AnaptysBio, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026, announcing the completion of a spin-off of First Tracks Biotherapeutics, Inc. as a separate publicly traded company. The distribution was executed on a pro rata basis, with shareholders receiving one TRAX share for each ANAB share held as of the April 6, 2026 record date. First Tracks Biotherapeutics began trading on Nasdaq under ticker 'TRAX' on April 20, 2026. This is a corporate restructuring event with no direct relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: AnaptysBio completed the spin-off of First Tracks Biotherapeutics on April 20, 2026 (Distribution Date) at 12:01 a.m. NYC time
Record date for the distribution was April 6, 2026; holders received one TRAX share for every one ANAB share held
First Tracks Biotherapeutics common stock began trading on Nasdaq under ticker symbol 'TRAX' on April 20, 2026
Separation and Distribution Agreement governs the transfer of assets and assumption of liabilities between the two entities
AnaptysBio retains the Royalty Management Co. Business (dostarlimab/Jemperli royalties, imsidolimab royalties)
First Tracks Biotherapeutics retains the biotech business focused on autoimmune/inflammatory disease therapeutics
